scheme_name: Scheme of Extending Financial Assistance to Folk Artists, Troupes for the Purchase of Musical Instruments, Costumes
other_conditions: Applicant must be continuously performing in the programs
Applicant must have performed in the programs for more than three years
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 for individual folk artists and ₹6,000 for cultural troupes for purchase of musical instruments and costumes.
